candidate_sentences.text: After EUR 178.5 million of financing outflows, including EUR 44.6 million in dividends and EUR 97.6 million in loan repayments, cash declined to EUR 13.5 million.
Net debt nevertheless fell to EUR 432.4 million from EUR 537.7 million, while the equity ratio improved to 56.4%.
